findingDetails.title: Doctor probe output does not preserve custom prompts as a replayable command
findingDetails.case: A caller supplies a custom --prompt containing an embedded quote or shell expansion, then copies the reported probe command to reproduce a result.
findingDetails.evidence: The display command interpolates raw prompt text inside double quotes. The actual child call passes the prompt as an argv element, and report() prints the display string on both PASS and FAIL rows.
findingDetails.userImpact: Shell parsing can change or expand the prompt in the displayed command, making a failed route harder to reproduce and diagnose.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct inspection of the only prompt-bearing command display and its paired run() call shows this issue is local to the probe leg; the launched probe uses spawnSync argv.
findingDetails.recommendation: Render the command from shell-escaped argv or label the text as a diagnostic description that is not safe to copy.
findingDetails.claim: The report's probe command does not round-trip shell-sensitive custom prompt values.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the custom prompt is executed by the checker or only inserted into a display string; the child call receives argv and the report prints the display string.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The command text may be a compact diagnostic label rather than a copyable shell command, but it is formatted as a command next to each result.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Remove this advisory if the report labels the string as illustrative and does not imply that it is a replay command.

searchActions.result: The display string inserts raw prompt text in double quotes; report() prints it, while run() passes the original prompt as argv.

searchLedger.rationale: The diagnostic string and executed argv diverge for shell-sensitive prompt values.

searchLedger.invariant: Custom prompt text must remain an argv value when the setup checker launches the compiled route probe.

searchActions.result: spawnLeg calls spawnSync with an argv array and no shell option; the custom prompt is passed as a separate argument.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Direct inspection confirms argv-based spawning; the finding is limited to the string displayed for humans.
